instructions.description: This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case.

overview.description: Litware is a manufacturing company that has offices throughout North America.

fabricEnvironment.description: Litware has been using a Microsoft Power BI tenant for three years.

availableData.description: Litware has data that must be analyzed as shown in the following table.
surveyBehavior: One row is added to the Survey table.
One row is added to the Response table for each question in the survey.
The Question table contains the text of each survey question.
The third question in each survey response is an overall satisfaction score.
Customers can submit a survey after each purchase.

userProblems: The analytics team has large volumes of data, some of which is semi-structured.
The team wants to use Fabric to create a new data store.
Product pricing logic is duplicated across multiple systems and is not always consistent.

workspaces.name: AnalyticsPOC
workspaces.purpose: Contains the data store, semantic models, reports, pipelines, dataflows and notebooks.

workspaces.name: DataEngPOC
workspaces.purpose: Contains all pipelines, dataflows and notebooks used to populate OneLake.

workspaces.name: DataSciPOC
workspaces.purpose: Contains notebooks and reports used by data scientists.

loadingPattern.rule: Raw and cleansed zones must finish updating before dimensional model loading begins.

requirements: Only Fabric administrators and analytics team members can view PoC items.
Data engineers require read/write access only.
Analytics engineers require schema, semantic model and report management capabilities.
Data scientists require read-only access through Spark notebooks.
Data analysts require access only to dimensional model objects.
Date dimension must be available to all users.
Follow the principle of least privilege.

reportRequirements: Filter survey results by purchased product.
Include only the current and previous calendar year.
